sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已上线，欢迎在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Hey, guess what?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: I found a cat.
sentences.zh: 我捡到了一只猫。

sentences.en: No way.
sentences.zh: 不会吧。

sentences.en: Yep, 12 years ago at a pet shelter.
sentences.zh: 真的，12年前在一家宠物收容所捡到的。

sentences.en: She's been at my house ever since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后她就一直住在我家。

sentences.en: Keep your cat safe at home.
sentences.zh: 请让你的猫安全待在家里。

sentences.en: They'll live 70% longer on average.
sentences.zh: 它们的平均寿命会延长70%。

sentences.en: A message from RSPCA NSW with support from the Environmental TruSt.
sentences.zh: 本公益信息由新南威尔士州皇家防止虐待动物协会（RSPCA NSW）提供，并得到了环境信托基金（Environmental Trust）的支持。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人不安的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候感到需要支持，请联系您当地的危机中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 如需获取保密支持的电话号码建议，请查看您应用中本集节目的说明，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: In the early hours of Saturday March 16, 1996,
sentences.zh: 1996年3月16日星期六凌晨，

sentences.en: John Haggard awoke to the acrid odour of something burning.
sentences.zh: 约翰·哈格特被一股刺鼻的焦糊味熏醒了。

sentences.en: It was around 1.20am, and the 17-year-old had only been asleep for a couple of hours.
sentences.zh: 当时大约是凌晨1点20分，这位17岁的少年才睡着没几个小时。

sentences.en: John was at home with his two younger brothers, 15-year-old Lawrence and 12-year-old Dennis.
sentences.zh: 约翰当时正和两个弟弟在家，分别是15岁的劳伦斯和12岁的丹尼斯。

sentences.en: The boy's mother, Janet, had gone out the previous evening to celebrate a relative's birthday.
sentences.zh: 男孩们的母亲珍妮特前一天晚上出门去参加一位亲戚的生日聚会了。

sentences.en: The outing was a rare treat for Janet, a single mother who spent most of her time caring for her sons.
sentences.zh: 对于身为单亲母亲、大部分时间都在照顾儿子的珍妮特来说，这次外出是一次难得的放松。

sentences.en: As the oldest of his siblings, John was in charge until her return.
sentences.zh: 作为兄弟中的长子，约翰在母亲回来前负责照看家里。

sentences.en: As John awoke, he saw heavy curtains of smoke wafting through his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 约翰醒来时，看到浓烟正从卧室门缝中涌入。

sentences.en: He scrambled out of bed and rushed out the door.
sentences.zh: 他从床上爬起来，冲出了房门。

sentences.en: The smoke was rising up the staircase from the ground floor below.
sentences.zh: 浓烟正从楼下的底层顺着楼梯向上蔓延。

sentences.en: It was accompanied by a noise that sounded like heavy breathing or snoring.
sentences.zh: 伴随着浓烟的还有一种听起来像是沉重呼吸声或鼾声的动静。

sentences.en: John headed downstairs and followed the smoke to its origin point, the living room.
sentences.zh: 约翰下楼顺着烟雾找到了源头——客厅。

sentences.en: He entered the darkened room and saw his 15-year-old brother, Lawrence, lying on the floor in his underwear.
sentences.zh: 他走进漆黑的房间，看到15岁的弟弟劳伦斯只穿着内衣躺在地板上。

sentences.en: His head was bruised and bleeding, as was his shoulder.
sentences.zh: 他的头部有淤青和血迹，肩膀也是如此。

sentences.en: Lawrence didn't stir, but John could hear his brother's laboured breaths.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯一动不动，但约翰能听到弟弟沉重的呼吸声。

sentences.en: A fire crackled at Lawrence's feet and was spreading up his legs.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯的脚边燃着一团火，火势正顺着他的双腿向上蔓延。

sentences.en: John tried to drag Lawrence out of the room, but his unconscious body was too heavy.
sentences.zh: 约翰试图把劳伦斯拖出房间，但失去知觉的身体太沉了。

sentences.en: He managed to pull Lawrence far enough away from the fire, then rushed to get a bucket of water.
sentences.zh: 他好不容易把劳伦斯拖离火源，然后冲去接了一桶水。

sentences.en: He poured it out over Lawrence's burning feet, dousing the flames.
sentences.zh: 他把水泼在劳伦斯燃烧的双脚上，扑灭了火焰。

sentences.en: As he tended to his badly injured brother, John noticed the front door to the house was open.
sentences.zh: 在照顾受伤严重的弟弟时，约翰注意到家里的前门开着。

sentences.en: He could see out to the street, but no one was around.
sentences.zh: 他能看到外面的街道，但周围空无一人。

sentences.en: John sprinted back upstairs and entered the bedroom that Lawrence shared with their youngest brother, 12-year-old Dennis.
sentences.zh: 约翰飞奔回楼上，进入了劳伦斯和12岁的小弟丹尼斯共用的卧室。

sentences.en: The room was filled with smoke, but Dennis appeared sound asleep in his bed.
sentences.zh: 房间里烟雾弥漫，但丹尼斯似乎在床上睡得很沉。

sentences.en: John roused him and told him that Lawrence was hurt downstairs.
sentences.zh: 约翰叫醒了他，告诉他劳伦斯在楼下受伤了。

sentences.en: At around this time, Janet Haggart returned home after her night out.
sentences.zh: 大约就在这时，珍妮特·哈格特结束了晚上的聚会回到了家。

sentences.en: Upon discovering Lawrence's bloodied and burnt body, she let out a deafening shriek and began wailing loudly.
sentences.zh: 当发现劳伦斯血迹斑斑且被烧伤的身体时，她发出了震耳欲聋的尖叫，开始嚎啕大哭。

sentences.en: John had to phone 999 Emergency from the bathroom so that the operator could hear him over his mother's distress.
sentences.zh: 约翰不得不躲在浴室里拨打999急救电话，这样接线员才能在母亲的哀号声中听清他的话。

sentences.en: Paramedics and the police arrived at the haggard home within minutes.
sentences.zh: 救护人员和警察在几分钟内就赶到了哈格特家。

sentences.en: Lawrence was still alive, but unresponsive.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯还活着，但没有反应。

sentences.en: He was rushed to hospital.
sentences.zh: 他被紧急送往医院。

sentences.en: The brutal attack was as inexplicable as it was shocking.
sentences.zh: 这场残忍的袭击既令人震惊，又令人费解。

sentences.en: Lawrence was popular and well-liked and got on well with his brothers and mother.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯很受欢迎，人缘很好，和兄弟及母亲的关系也很融洽。

sentences.en: The family of four lived in the small town of Larbert in the Falkirk Council area of Scotland.
sentences.zh: 这四口之家住在苏格兰福尔柯克议会区的一个小镇拉伯特。

sentences.en: Their home was one of dozens of matching, two-storey, semi-detached houses on Glenburvie Drive.
sentences.zh: 他们的家是格伦伯维大道上几十栋外观相同的双层半独立式住宅之一。

sentences.en: Cramped and box-like, the houses were packed in a large estate characterised by narrow roads, enclosed rear gardens, and front doors a few metres away from the street.
sentences.zh: 这些房子狭窄拥挤，坐落在一个大型住宅区内，特点是道路狭窄、后花园封闭，前门距离街道仅几米之遥。

sentences.en: Lawrence was named after his father, who went by the nickname Larry.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯是以他父亲的名字命名的，他父亲的绰号叫拉里。

sentences.en: By 1996, Janet and Larry Haggart had been separated for three years.
sentences.zh: 到1996年时，珍妮特和拉里·哈格特已经分居三年了。

sentences.en: While the couple's sons lived with their mother, they remained close to their father.
sentences.zh: 虽然儿子们和母亲住在一起，但他们与父亲依然保持着亲密的关系。

sentences.en: Larry lived four miles west of Larbert, in the village of Dunipace, where he worked as a painter and decorator.
sentences.zh: 拉里住在拉伯特以西四英里的杜尼佩斯村，在那里做油漆工和装饰工。

sentences.en: He stayed nearby to his boys and maintained a close relationship with them.
sentences.zh: 他住在离儿子们很近的地方，并与他们保持着密切的联系。

sentences.en: Lawrence inherited more than just his father's name.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯继承的不仅仅是父亲的名字。

sentences.en: He also shared his passion and skill for football or soccer.
sentences.zh: 他还继承了父亲对足球的热爱和天赋。

sentences.en: Years prior, Larry Haggart had played for the semi-professional football club, Allewa Athletic.
sentences.zh: 多年前，拉里·哈格特曾为半职业足球俱乐部阿勒瓦竞技队效力。

sentences.en: It was clear from a young age that Lawrence would follow in his father's footsteps.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯从小就显露出会追随父亲脚步的迹象。

sentences.en: In Scotland, professional football clubs offered schoolboy forms to promising young players between the ages of nine and sixteen.
sentences.zh: 在苏格兰，职业足球俱乐部会为9到16岁之间有前途的年轻球员提供学徒合同。

sentences.en: Chosen boys received special training, with a chance to play for their respective clubs later on down the track.
sentences.zh: 入选的男孩会接受专门训练，并有机会在未来为各自的俱乐部效力。

sentences.en: In 1995, Lawrence's dream came true when he signed schoolboy forms for Celtic, an elite Scottish football club.
sentences.zh: 1995年，劳伦斯的梦想成真了，他与苏格兰顶级足球俱乐部凯尔特人队签署了学徒合同。

sentences.en: The placement meant a lot to the team.
sentences.zh: 这个名额对球队意义重大。

sentences.en: His great-uncle had played for Celtic, and it was the team Lawrence had supported his entire life.
sentences.zh: 他的叔祖父曾为凯尔特人队效力，这也是劳伦斯一生支持的球队。

sentences.en: It was expected that he would sign professional forms with the club in December 1996, taking him one step closer to a career as a star footballer.
sentences.zh: 人们预计他会在1996年12月与俱乐部签署职业合同，这将使他离成为明星足球运动员的目标更近一步。

sentences.en: Lawrence was so talented that he was selected for Scotland's international under-15 squad.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯天赋异禀，入选了苏格兰国际U15代表队。

sentences.en: Three days before he was attacked in his home, he'd made his on-field debut against Belgium.
sentences.zh: 在他家中遇袭的三天前，他刚刚完成了对阵比利时队的赛场首秀。

sentences.en: His team won.
sentences.zh: 他的球队赢了。

sentences.en: Although it was anticipated that Lawrence would go on to achieve glory on the football field, he had a backup plan in case things didn't work out.
sentences.zh: 虽然人们预计劳伦斯会在足球场上取得辉煌成就，但他还是准备了后备计划，以防万一。

sentences.en: He would pursue his passion for sport by becoming a physical education teacher.
sentences.zh: 他打算通过成为一名体育老师来追求自己对运动的热爱。

sentences.en: As Lawrence underwent life-saving surgery, his home was cordoned off as a crime scene.
sentences.zh: 在劳伦斯接受救命手术的同时，他的家被封锁为犯罪现场。

sentences.en: Attending police officers were quickly joined by forensic scientists and members of Central Scotland's Fire Brigade.
sentences.zh: 赶到的警察很快与法医科学家及苏格兰中部消防队的成员汇合。

sentences.en: Charles Collier was a divisional officer with the Fire Brigade.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·科利尔是消防队的一名分区官员。

sentences.en: He examined the charred remnants of the pyre that had been lit by Lawrence's feet in the living room.
sentences.zh: 他检查了客厅里劳伦斯脚边那堆被点燃的余烬。

sentences.en: It was made from a pile of clothes, a checked shirt, a pair of jeans, and two boots.
sentences.zh: 那是由一堆衣服组成的，包括一件格子衬衫、一条牛仔裤和两只靴子。

sentences.en: It appeared as though Lawrence's attacker had dragged his body to the spot after the initial attack.
sentences.zh: 看起来劳伦斯的袭击者在最初的袭击后，将他的身体拖到了那个位置。

sentences.en: The carpet underneath featured a scorch mark in the shape of a semicircle.
sentences.zh: 下方的地毯上有一个半圆形的焦痕。

sentences.en: Officer Collier could tell it had been deliberately lit, but couldn't find any trace of an accelerant.
sentences.zh: 科利尔警官能看出这是蓄意点燃的，但没能找到任何助燃剂的痕迹。

sentences.en: A second fire had also spread from a nearby couch.
sentences.zh: 第二处火源也从附近的沙发蔓延开来。

sentences.en: A duvet was crumpled on top of it.
sentences.zh: 上面堆着一条皱巴巴的羽绒被。

sentences.en: It appeared as though a lighter was held up to it, after which flames had fanned upwards.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是有人用打火机点燃了它，随后火焰向上窜起。

sentences.en: This fire also looked deliberate.
sentences.zh: 这场火看起来也是蓄意的。

sentences.en: The arsonist had likely hoped that either fire would take hold and rapidly destroy the house, consuming the victim and any evidence linking them to the crime.
sentences.zh: 纵火者很可能希望其中任何一场火灾能迅速蔓延并烧毁房屋，从而吞噬受害者和任何将他们与犯罪联系起来的证据。

sentences.en: There was no sign of forced entry into the house.
sentences.zh: 屋内没有强行闯入的迹象。

sentences.en: John Haggart claimed that the front door was open when he entered the living room and found Lawrence.
sentences.zh: 约翰·哈格特声称他进入客厅发现劳伦斯时，前门是开着的。

sentences.en: He didn't see anyone fleeing.
sentences.zh: 他没有看到任何人逃跑。

sentences.en: Police suspected that the culprit either knocked on the front door or was already inside before launching their attack.
sentences.zh: 警方怀疑凶手要么是敲门进入的，要么在发动袭击前就已经在屋内了。

sentences.en: A search of the property failed to uncover the weapon used to inflict Lawrence's injuries.
sentences.zh: 对房产的搜查未能找到造成劳伦斯受伤的凶器。

sentences.en: Near 30 miles southeast of Larbert, 36-year-old Larry Haggart arrived at Edinburgh's Western General Hospital.
sentences.zh: 在拉伯特东南约30英里处，36岁的拉里·哈格特抵达了爱丁堡的西部总医院。

sentences.en: He'd received a call notifying him that his second eldest son had been in an accident.
sentences.zh: 他接到电话，通知他次子出了事故。

sentences.en: He arrived quickly, but no one was able to give him a clear explanation.
sentences.zh: 他很快赶到，但没人能给他一个明确的解释。

sentences.en: All he was told was that Lawrence sustained blunt force trauma to the head.
sentences.zh: 他只被告知劳伦斯的头部受到了钝器伤害。

sentences.en: It had resulted in brain damage and a massive skull fracture that extended to the right side of his face.
sentences.zh: 这导致了脑损伤和严重的颅骨骨折，骨折延伸到了他脸部的右侧。

sentences.en: Lawrence underwent emergency surgery and was placed on life support.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯接受了紧急手术，并被送入重症监护室依靠生命维持系统维持生命。

sentences.en: Larry joined Janet at their son's side, where the pair kept a vigil into the following morning of Sunday March 17.
sentences.zh: 拉里和珍妮特守在儿子身边，两人一直守候到次日，即3月17日星期日的清晨。

sentences.en: The brutal attack made local news, though Lawrence's identity was withheld as some of his relatives had yet to be informed.
sentences.zh: 这起残忍的袭击登上了当地新闻，但劳伦斯的身份被保密，因为他的一些亲属尚未得到通知。

sentences.en: An article in the Sunday Mail newspaper did mention that a rising Celtic star was fighting for his life.
sentences.zh: 《星期日邮报》的一篇文章确实提到了一位凯尔特人队的明日之星正在为生命而战。

sentences.en: Celtic youth team boss Willie McStay told the paper,
sentences.zh: 凯尔特人青年队主教练威利·麦克斯泰告诉报社：

sentences.en: Let's just hope to God he pulls through.
sentences.zh: 让我们祈祷他能挺过来吧。

sentences.en: Later that day, it was determined that Lawrence would not recover from his injuries.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，医生判定劳伦斯无法从伤势中恢复。

sentences.en: A priest arrived at the hospital and gave the 15-year-old his last rites.
sentences.zh: 一位牧师来到医院，为这位15岁的少年进行了临终祈祷。

sentences.en: Lawrence's ventilator was turned off and he quietly passed away.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯的呼吸机被关闭，他平静地离开了人世。

sentences.en: His death rocked Scotland's footballing community.
sentences.zh: 他的死震惊了苏格兰足球界。

sentences.en: Celtic manager Tommy Burns told the local press that the club was shocked.
sentences.zh: 凯尔特人队主教练汤米·伯恩斯告诉当地媒体，俱乐部感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: He expressed his condolences to the Haggard family.
sentences.zh: 他向哈格特一家表达了哀悼。

sentences.en: The coach of Scotland's international under-15 squad echoed these sentiments, telling reporters,
sentences.zh: 苏格兰国际U15代表队的主教练也表达了同样的感受，他告诉记者：

sentences.en: Lawrence had great pace and vision.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯有着极佳的速度和视野。

sentences.en: He was just at the beginning of what would certainly have been a top-class career.
sentences.zh: 他才刚刚开始一段本注定会成为顶级职业生涯的旅程。

sentences.en: Because Lawrence had undergone significant surgery, it was impossible to determine exactly how many times he was struck to the head.
sentences.zh: 由于劳伦斯接受了大规模手术，无法确定他的头部究竟被击中了多少次。

sentences.en: But it was clear that the attack had been extremely violent and carried out with a heavy object.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，这次袭击极其暴力，且是用重物实施的。

sentences.en: It had caused skull fractures similar to those sustained by road accident victims who've been thrown through the windscreen of a car.
sentences.zh: 这造成的颅骨骨折与那些被甩出车外、撞碎挡风玻璃的车祸受害者所受的伤类似。

sentences.en: His legs and his feet were severely burnt, exposing the tissue underneath.
sentences.zh: 他的双腿和双脚被严重烧伤，露出了下面的组织。

sentences.en: The soles of both feet were charred black.
sentences.zh: 双脚的脚底被烧成了焦黑色。

sentences.en: There were no defensive injuries or wounds consistent with the fight.
sentences.zh: 身上没有防御性伤口，也没有符合打斗特征的痕迹。

sentences.en: It appeared as though Lawrence was taken by surprise, either by an individual or multiple offenders.
sentences.zh: 看起来劳伦斯是被单个人或多名罪犯突袭的。

sentences.en: The teen had also been mutilated.
sentences.zh: 这名少年还遭到了毁容。

sentences.en: The numbers 110 had been gouged into one of Lawrence's shoulders, most likely with a key.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯的一侧肩膀上被刻上了“110”的数字，很可能是用钥匙刻的。

sentences.en: Both of his palms had the same number written on them in ink.
sentences.zh: 他的两个手掌上都用墨水写着同样的数字。

sentences.en: Police resources at the time of Lawrence's murder were limited, as it occurred just days after an unrelated national tragedy.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯遇害时，警方的资源非常有限，因为这起案件发生在一场无关的全国性悲剧发生几天后。

sentences.en: At 9.30am on Wednesday March 13, a 43-year-old man entered Dunblane Primary School near the city of Stirling.
sentences.zh: 3月13日星期三上午9点30分，一名43岁的男子进入了斯特灵市附近的邓布兰小学。

sentences.en: Armed with four legally owned handguns, he opened fire on a class of 28 students.
sentences.zh: 他携带四把合法拥有的手枪，向一个有28名学生的班级开火。

sentences.en: 16 children aged between 5 and 6 years old were killed, as was their 45-year-old teacher.
sentences.zh: 16名5到6岁的儿童和他们45岁的老师不幸遇难。

sentences.en: A further 15 children were injured.
sentences.zh: 另有15名儿童受伤。

sentences.en: The gunman then took his own life.
sentences.zh: 枪手随后自杀身亡。

sentences.en: The attack would come to be known as the Dunblane Massacre and remains the deadliest mass shooting in British history.
sentences.zh: 这次袭击后来被称为“邓布兰大屠杀”，至今仍是英国历史上伤亡最惨重的大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: Much of Scotland's police resources were channelled into investigating the major incident.
sentences.zh: 苏格兰的大部分警力都被投入到了对这起重大事件的调查中。

sentences.en: Lawrence Haggart's case was relegated to Central Scotland Police.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯·哈格特案被降级交由苏格兰中部警方处理。

sentences.en: They had jurisdiction over the council areas of Falkirk, Stirling and Clackmannenshire.
sentences.zh: 他们对福尔柯克、斯特灵和克拉克曼南郡的议会区拥有管辖权。

sentences.en: The high-profile case was, in hindsight, a lot for the small force to handle.
sentences.zh: 事后看来，这起备受瞩目的案件对于这支小警队来说负担太重了。

sentences.en: The Haggart homicide investigation was led by Detective Superintendent Jim Winning and his second-in-command, Detective Inspector John Bunyan.
sentences.zh: 哈格特谋杀案的调查由警司吉姆·温宁领导，他的副手是督察约翰·邦扬。

sentences.en: Lawrence's final hours were pieced together based on the statements of those he interacted with during that time.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯生命中最后几个小时的情况是根据他当时接触过的人的陈述拼凑出来的。

sentences.en: Hours before he was attacked, Lawrence had gone out with friends to an underage nightclub called Ziggy's in the nearby town of Denny.
sentences.zh: 在遇袭前几个小时，劳伦斯曾和朋友去了附近丹尼镇一家名为“Ziggy's”的未成年人夜店。

sentences.en: A neighbour observed him leaving home.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居看到他离开家。

sentences.en: He was dressed in cream-coloured jeans, a white T-shirt, a dark blue and white striped top, a cream bomber jacket and brown boots.
sentences.zh: 他当时穿着米色牛仔裤、白色T恤、蓝白条纹上衣、米色飞行员夹克和棕色靴子。

sentences.en: He met up with friends and the group went to Ziggy's.
sentences.zh: 他与朋友会合，一行人去了Ziggy's。

sentences.en: Lawrence wasn't the type to stay out later than allowed, so he left the club just before ten.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯不是那种会逾期不归的人，所以他在十点前就离开了夜店。

sentences.en: Together with a friend, he caught a taxi outside the Lion and Dragon pub, which was located in a narrow alleyway called Church Walk.
sentences.zh: 他和一位朋友在“狮子与龙”酒吧外打了一辆出租车，酒吧位于一条名为“教堂步道”的狭窄小巷里。

sentences.en: When they reached the small village of Bonny Bridge, Lawrence's friend exited the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达邦尼布里奇小村庄时，劳伦斯的朋友下了车。

sentences.en: Lawrence continued on in the taxi alone for another three miles.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯独自乘坐出租车又行驶了三英里。

sentences.en: He got out at the village of Camelon, south of La Berte.
sentences.zh: 他在拉伯特以南的卡梅伦村下了车。

sentences.en: A witness spotted him walking towards the Falkirk Sheriff Court building.
sentences.zh: 一名目击者看到他正朝福尔柯克治安法院大楼走去。

sentences.en: He walked the remaining two miles home.
sentences.zh: 他步行走完了剩下的两英里路程回到了家。

sentences.en: John was alone in the living room watching television when Lawrence walked through the door at 10.30pm.
sentences.zh: 晚上10点30分劳伦斯进门时，约翰正独自在客厅看电视。

sentences.en: Dennis was still out, but arrived home a short while later.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯当时还没回来，但不久后也到家了。

sentences.en: Lawrence spoke briefly to his brothers, then settled on the sofa and read a newspaper.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯和兄弟们简单说了几句话，然后坐在沙发上看报纸。

sentences.en: John and Dennis went to their respective beds.
sentences.zh: 约翰和丹尼斯各自回房睡觉了。

sentences.en: After a little while, Dennis got up to fetch some crisps from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，丹尼斯起床去厨房拿薯片。

sentences.en: From upstairs, John heard his two younger brothers talking and the sound of a kitchen cupboard closing.
sentences.zh: 约翰在楼上听到了两个弟弟的谈话声，还有厨房橱柜关上的声音。

sentences.en: He then fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 随后他就睡着了。

sentences.en: Dennis went back to bed.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯回到了床上。

sentences.en: Shortly afterwards, he thought he heard Lawrence enter their bedroom, pick up his duvet, then go downstairs.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他以为自己听见劳伦斯进了卧室，拿走了被子，然后下楼去了。

sentences.en: Investigators were unable to establish a clear motive.
sentences.zh: 调查人员无法确定明确的动机。

sentences.en: They briefly considered the possibility that it was sexual, as Lawrence was found in nothing else but his underwear.
sentences.zh: 他们曾短暂考虑过性动机的可能性，因为发现劳伦斯时他只穿着内衣。

sentences.en: Most of the clothing he had worn to the club was used to start the fire at his feet.
sentences.zh: 他去俱乐部时穿的大部分衣服都被用来在他脚下纵火了。

sentences.en: One convicted sex offender was initially of interest to police, but was quickly ruled out after providing an alibi.
sentences.zh: 一名被定罪的性犯罪者最初引起了警方的注意，但在提供不在场证明后很快被排除嫌疑。

sentences.en: Rumours spread that the murder was motivated by Lawrence's affiliation with Celtic Football Club.
sentences.zh: 有传言称，这起谋杀案的动机与劳伦斯加入凯尔特人足球俱乐部有关。

sentences.en: The club had a historic association with Irish immigrants who'd moved to Glasgow and Scots of Irish descent.
sentences.zh: 该俱乐部与移居格拉斯哥的爱尔兰移民以及爱尔兰裔苏格兰人有着历史渊源。

sentences.en: This meant it also had strong ties to the Catholic Church, of which Lawrence was a member.
sentences.zh: 这意味着它也与天主教会联系紧密，而劳伦斯正是该教会的成员。

sentences.en: Some speculated that the attack was the result of anti-Catholic prejudice.
sentences.zh: 有人推测这次袭击是反天主教偏见的结果。

sentences.en: Lawrence's mother, Lawrence's mother, Janet, was too distraught by her son's murder to speak about the matter publicly,
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯的母亲珍妮特因儿子的遇害而悲痛欲绝，无法公开谈论此事，

sentences.en: so his father, Larry, took on the role of family spokesperson.
sentences.zh: 因此他的父亲拉里承担起了家庭发言人的角色。

sentences.en: Larry expressed his doubt that his son had been killed due to anti-Catholic prejudice.
sentences.zh: 拉里表示怀疑儿子是因为反天主教偏见而遇害的。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, March 19, police officially dismissed this theory.
sentences.zh: 3月19日星期二，警方正式排除了这一理论。

sentences.en: Superintendent Jim Winning said,
sentences.zh: 吉姆·威宁警司说：

sentences.en: There has been talk of a sectarian motive, but let me say that there is nothing so far in this inquiry to suggest that.
sentences.zh: “有关于宗派动机的说法，但请允许我说，目前的调查中没有任何迹象表明这一点。”

sentences.en: We have no suspects at the moment, and I would say that this is a seemingly motiveless attack.
sentences.zh: “我们目前没有嫌疑人，我想说这是一起看似毫无动机的袭击。”

sentences.en: Police were quick to take possession of the Haggart family home.
sentences.zh: 警方很快接管了哈格特家宅。

sentences.en: Janet Haggart and her sons were unable to return to the house while the initial investigation was underway.
sentences.zh: 在初步调查期间，珍妮特·哈格特和她的儿子们无法回到家中。

sentences.en: The restrictions meant little to Janet, who avoided the property permanently following Lawrence's attack.
sentences.zh: 这些限制对珍妮特来说意义不大，因为在劳伦斯遇袭后，她就永久地避开了那处房产。

sentences.en: On Friday, March 22, Detective Sergeant Robert Beveridge attended the house to collect clothing for the Haggart family.
sentences.zh: 3月22日星期五，侦缉警长罗伯特·贝弗里奇前往该房屋为哈格特一家收集衣物。

sentences.en: He'd also been told of a potential issue with the property's electricity and needed to check whether a power cord was needed.
sentences.zh: 他还被告知该房产的电力可能存在问题，需要检查是否需要电源线。

sentences.en: While Detective Beveridge was in the kitchen, he caught a glimpse of something out of the corner of his eye.
sentences.zh: 当贝弗里奇警探在厨房时，他眼角的余光瞥见了一些东西。

sentences.en: Lying along the side of the kitchen table was a hammer.
sentences.zh: 厨房桌子边上躺着一把锤子。

sentences.en: Detective Beveridge pulled on a latex glove.
sentences.zh: 贝弗里奇警探戴上了一只乳胶手套。

sentences.en: He then picked up the tool and noticed what appeared to be a human hair stuck to it.
sentences.zh: 他随后捡起工具，注意到上面似乎粘着一根人的头发。

sentences.en: The detective confiscated the item as evidence.
sentences.zh: 警探将该物品作为证据没收了。

sentences.en: Lawrence's funeral was held on Saturday April 20.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯的葬礼于4月20日星期六举行。

sentences.en: Approximately 500 mourners packed into the St. Alexander Roman Catholic Church in Stirling to farewell the young soccer star.
sentences.zh: 大约500名哀悼者挤进了斯特灵的圣亚历山大罗马天主教堂，为这位年轻的足球明星送行。

sentences.en: The Celtic football club's entire first squad attended, dressed in the team's green and black tracksuits.
sentences.zh: 凯尔特人足球俱乐部的整支一线队都出席了，他们身穿球队的绿黑运动服。

sentences.en: They were joined by the club's youth teams and top-ranking officials.
sentences.zh: 俱乐部的青年队和高层官员也一同参加。

sentences.en: The officiating priest addressed Lawrence's unknown killer or killers, stating,
sentences.zh: 主持仪式的牧师向劳伦斯那未知的凶手或凶手们喊话，说道：

sentences.en: Lawrence was laid to rest at the hills of the Dunipace Cemetery in Falkirk, just five minutes from his father's home.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯被安葬在福尔柯克的杜尼佩斯公墓山上，距离他父亲的家仅五分钟路程。

sentences.en: Larry visited his son's grave daily to deliver fresh flowers and clean the headstone.
sentences.zh: 拉里每天都会去儿子的墓前献上鲜花并擦拭墓碑。

sentences.en: A £1,000 reward for information leading to the identification of Lawrence's killer went unclaimed.
sentences.zh: 一笔用于奖励提供线索以查明劳伦斯凶手身份的1000英镑奖金无人认领。

sentences.en: The local community feared the violent killer was hiding amongst them and lived in constant anxiety, worried they'd strike again at any moment.
sentences.zh: 当地社区担心凶残的杀手就藏在他们中间，终日惶惶不安，担心他们随时会再次行凶。

sentences.en: In contrast, investigators were growing increasingly convinced that the perpetrator was closer to home.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，调查人员越来越确信肇事者就在身边。

sentences.en: They were primarily struck by the fact that there was no sign of forced entry in the Haggart house.
sentences.zh: 令他们印象最深的是，哈格特家中没有强行闯入的迹象。

sentences.en: Dennis Haggart was only 12 years old, but he was big for his age and physically strong.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·哈格特当时只有12岁，但他长得比同龄人高大，身体强壮。

sentences.en: Despite being the youngest of the three Haggart boys, he appeared capable of overpowering both his brothers in a fight.
sentences.zh: 尽管是哈格特家三个男孩中最小的一个，但他看起来在打架时有能力制服两个哥哥。

sentences.en: From the outset of their investigation, Central Scotland Police eyed Dennis with suspicion.
sentences.zh: 从调查一开始，苏格兰中部警方就对丹尼斯投以怀疑的目光。

sentences.en: They believed he had been jealous of Lawrence's success on the football field, and these feelings came to a head on Friday March 15.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他一直嫉妒劳伦斯在足球场上的成功，而这些情绪在3月15日星期五达到了顶点。

sentences.en: It was theorised that Dennis confronted Lawrence that night, before lashing out in a fit of deadly rage.
sentences.zh: 据推测，丹尼斯那天晚上与劳伦斯发生了冲突，随后在极度愤怒中痛下杀手。

sentences.en: Detective Superintendent Jim Winning and Detective Inspector John Bunyan questioned Dennis.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·威宁侦缉警司和约翰·邦扬侦缉督察对丹尼斯进行了审问。

sentences.en: He maintained that he was proud of his older brother's football talents and wasn't at all envious.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己为哥哥的足球天赋感到骄傲，一点也不嫉妒。

sentences.en: They also questioned the eldest Haggart's son, 17-year-old John.
sentences.zh: 他们还审问了哈格特家的大儿子，17岁的约翰。

sentences.en: He denied that his two younger brothers had argued the evening before the attack.
sentences.zh: 他否认两个弟弟在袭击发生前一天晚上有过争吵。

sentences.en: Yet, in another interview days later, John mentioned something he hadn't before.
sentences.zh: 然而，在几天后的另一次采访中，约翰提到了他之前没说过的事情。

sentences.en: After finding Lawrence's burning body in the living room, he rushed upstairs to alert Dennis.
sentences.zh: 在客厅发现劳伦斯燃烧的尸体后，他冲上楼去叫醒丹尼斯。

sentences.en: Dennis was usually a deep sleeper who took a while to rouse.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯通常睡得很沉，很难叫醒。

sentences.en: That night, Dennis woke up immediately.
sentences.zh: 但那天晚上，丹尼斯立刻就醒了。

sentences.en: Investigators continued to press both John and Dennis.
sentences.zh: 调查人员继续向约翰和丹尼斯施压。

sentences.en: Then, two weeks after the murder, John revealed another unknown detail to police.
sentences.zh: 然后，在谋杀案发生两周后，约翰向警方透露了另一个未知的细节。

sentences.en: He admitted that Dennis and Lawrence had a disagreement shortly before the attack.
sentences.zh: 他承认丹尼斯和劳伦斯在袭击发生前不久发生过争执。

sentences.en: He recalled Lawrence arriving home by his curfew that night, but Dennis had stayed out later than he was supposed to.
sentences.zh: 他回忆起劳伦斯那天晚上在宵禁前到家了，但丹尼斯在外面待的时间比他应该待的时间要长。

sentences.en: When Dennis walked through the door after 10.30, John was upset.
sentences.zh: 当丹尼斯在10点半之后走进门时，约翰很生气。

sentences.en: He shouted and accused Dennis of taking the mickey.
sentences.zh: 他大喊大叫，指责丹尼斯在胡闹。

sentences.en: Lawrence sided with John and agreed that Dennis should go to bed.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯站在约翰这边，同意丹尼斯应该去睡觉。

sentences.en: This angered Dennis.
sentences.zh: 这激怒了丹尼斯。

sentences.en: He told them to fuck off and retreated to the bedroom he and Lawrence shared.
sentences.zh: 他让他们滚蛋，然后退回了他和劳伦斯共用的卧室。

sentences.en: Lawrence went into the bedroom not long after.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，劳伦斯也进了卧室。

sentences.en: John overheard Dennis tell Lawrence to fuck off a second time.
sentences.zh: 约翰无意中听到丹尼斯第二次叫劳伦斯滚蛋。

sentences.en: The conflict likely prompted Lawrence to sleep on the couch.
sentences.zh: 这场冲突很可能促使劳伦斯去沙发上睡觉。

sentences.en: He collected the duvet from his bed and headed back downstairs to the living room.
sentences.zh: 他从床上拿了被子，又回到了楼下的客厅。

sentences.en: A short while later, John overheard Dennis go down to the kitchen to get a snack.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，约翰无意中听到丹尼斯下楼去厨房找零食吃。

sentences.en: He heard Lawrence rebuke him again, stating,
sentences.zh: 他听到劳伦斯再次斥责他，说道：

sentences.en: You are supposed to be in your bed.
sentences.zh: “你应该在床上睡觉。”

sentences.en: From the police's perspective, John's admissions proved they were right to suspect Dennis.
sentences.zh: 从警方的角度来看，约翰的供述证明他们怀疑丹尼斯是正确的。

sentences.en: There had clearly been some animosity between him and Lawrence on the night of the attack.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生当晚，他和劳伦斯之间显然存在一些敌意。

sentences.en: Over the following months, both John and Dennis were interviewed several times in order to get to the truth of the matter.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，约翰和丹尼斯都被多次审问，以查明事情的真相。

sentences.en: On one occasion, Dennis was held for six hours without arrest under the terms of the Criminal Justice Act.
sentences.zh: 有一次，根据《刑事司法法》的规定，丹尼斯在未被逮捕的情况下被拘留了六个小时。

sentences.en: The interview was recorded on tape, but he didn't implicate himself in the crime and maintained his innocence.
sentences.zh: 审讯过程被录了音，但他没有供认自己参与犯罪，并坚称自己是无辜的。

sentences.en: About two months after the murder, John Haggart shared another piece of information with investigators.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生约两个月后，约翰·哈格特与调查人员分享了另一条信息。

sentences.en: The police submitted a report to the country's Crown Office in which they said there was circumstantial evidence tying Dennis Haggart to Lawrence's murder.
sentences.zh: 警方提交了一份报告给国家的皇家检察署，称有间接证据将丹尼斯·哈格特与劳伦斯的谋杀案联系起来。

sentences.en: It also suggested that John might have also been involved.
sentences.zh: 报告还暗示约翰可能也参与其中。

sentences.en: Investigators told Larry Haggart that they had enough evidence to at least prove Dennis's guilt.
sentences.zh: 调查人员告诉拉里·哈格特，他们有足够的证据至少证明丹尼斯的罪行。

sentences.en: They asked him to speak with his son and get him to confess.
sentences.zh: 他们要求他与儿子谈谈，让他坦白。

sentences.en: But Larry refused.
sentences.zh: 但拉里拒绝了。

sentences.en: The suspicion around Dennis and John Haggart remained throughout March of 1996.
sentences.zh: 围绕丹尼斯和约翰·哈格特的怀疑一直持续到1996年3月。

sentences.en: The public were not informed that the brothers were being treated as suspects, but those within the Haggart family were well aware.
sentences.zh: 公众并不知道这对兄弟被当作嫌疑人对待，但哈格特家族内部的人对此心知肚明。

sentences.en: Privately, Larry Haggart was furious.
sentences.zh: 私下里，拉里·哈格特非常愤怒。

sentences.en: He hadn't heard from investigators since July and was left with the impression that they had abandoned the case in favour of blaming Lawrence's siblings.
sentences.zh: 自七月以来，他一直没有收到调查人员的消息，并留下了他们已经放弃案件转而指责劳伦斯兄弟姐妹的印象。

sentences.en: In an interview with the Sunday Mail in September that year, Larry revealed his plans to hire a private investigator to get to the truth of the matter.
sentences.zh: 在当年九月接受《星期日邮报》采访时，拉里透露了他聘请私家侦探以查明真相的计划。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: It is over two months since I heard from the police.
sentences.zh: “距离我上次收到警方消息已经过去两个多月了。”

sentences.en: While they didn't say the case was closed, they left me believing that their investigation is over.
sentences.zh: “虽然他们没有说案件已经结案，但他们的态度让我相信调查已经结束了。”

sentences.en: They may come down on me like a tonne of bricks for going at a loan, but I have a duty to my dead son to get some sort of conclusion.
sentences.zh: “如果我独自行动，他们可能会像泰山压顶一样来对付我，但我有责任为我死去的儿子寻求一个结论。”

sentences.en: The Sunday Mail sought a rebuttal from the investigating officers.
sentences.zh: 《星期日邮报》寻求调查警官的反驳。

sentences.en: Second in command, Detective Inspector John Bunyan said that police required more information before an arrest could be made.
sentences.zh: 二把手约翰·邦扬侦缉督察表示，警方在进行逮捕前需要更多信息。

sentences.en: He stated,
sentences.zh: 他表示：

sentences.en: Six months down the road, we need to know if anyone has been speaking about the case since the initial flurry of publicity.
sentences.zh: “六个月过去了，我们需要知道在最初的媒体曝光之后，是否有人在谈论这个案子。”

sentences.en: We know most of Lawrence's movements up to his death.
sentences.zh: “我们了解劳伦斯死前的大部分行踪。”

sentences.en: We need to know what happened in the final moments.
sentences.zh: “我们需要知道最后时刻发生了什么。”

sentences.en: Several months passed with no further developments in the case.
sentences.zh: 几个月过去了，案件没有任何进展。

sentences.en: Then, towards the end of 1996, it was announced that lead investigator, Detective Superintendent Jim Winning,
sentences.zh: 然后，在1996年底，有消息称首席调查员吉姆·威宁侦缉警司，

sentences.en: was being replaced as the head of the Criminal Investigation Division at Central Scotland Police.
sentences.zh: 将被撤换，不再担任苏格兰中部警方刑事调查部门的负责人。

sentences.en: Consequently, he would no longer be in charge of the Lawrence Haggart murder investigation.
sentences.zh: 因此，他将不再负责劳伦斯·哈格特谋杀案的调查。

sentences.en: He was replaced by Superintendent Joe Holden and his second in command, Detective Gordon Munro.
sentences.zh: 接替他的是乔·霍尔登警司和他的副手戈登·芒罗侦探。

sentences.en: As the one-year anniversary of Lawrence's murder drew near, the crime received renewed attention when it was featured on an episode of the UK television program, Crime Watch.
sentences.zh: 随着劳伦斯遇害一周年纪念日的临近，这起案件在英国电视节目《犯罪观察》的一集中播出，重新引起了关注。

sentences.en: Larry Haggart was in favour of the move as he hoped that the publicity might help jog someone's memory.
sentences.zh: 拉里·哈格特支持这一举动，因为他希望宣传能帮助唤起某人的记忆。

sentences.en: Yet, no leads emerged, further highlighting the possibility that those responsible were not hiding out in the community, but were remaining tight-lipped in the Haggart home.
sentences.zh: 然而，没有任何线索出现，这进一步突显了肇事者可能并没有躲在社区里，而是守口如瓶地待在哈格特家中。

sentences.en: In March 1997, a memorial mass was held at Lawrence's high school.
sentences.zh: 1997年3月，劳伦斯的高中举行了纪念弥撒。

sentences.en: In the lead-up, Larry Haggart spoke of his continued struggle with grief.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，拉里·哈格特谈到了他持续不断的悲痛挣扎。

sentences.en: He called Lawrence his best friend and said he visited his late son's grave every day.
sentences.zh: 他称劳伦斯是他最好的朋友，并说他每天都会去探望已故儿子的坟墓。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: People say it gets easier, but every day is as hard as the firSt.
sentences.zh: “人们说会好起来的，但每一天都和第一天一样难熬。”

sentences.en: By 1997, the family firmly believed in Dennis and John's innocence, while the police were certain of their guilt.
sentences.zh: 到1997年，家人坚定地相信丹尼斯和约翰是无辜的，而警方则确信他们有罪。

sentences.en: By the time Superintendent Joe Holden and Detective Gordon Munro took a fresh look at the case, the investigation had reached an impasse.
sentences.zh: 当乔·霍尔登警司和戈登·芒罗侦探重新审视此案时，调查已经陷入僵局。

sentences.en: As far as the original case detectives were concerned, Dennis and John Haggart were concealing the truth of what happened on March 16, 1996.
sentences.zh: 在最初的办案警探看来，丹尼斯和约翰·哈格特隐瞒了1996年3月16日发生的事情真相。

sentences.en: No other possible suspect had raised their suspicions as much as the Haggart boys.
sentences.zh: 没有其他可能的嫌疑人像哈格特兄弟那样引起他们的怀疑。

sentences.en: The Haggarts said that they only ever heard from investigators when they came to collect Dennis or John for questioning.
sentences.zh: 哈格特一家说，他们只有在警方来带走丹尼斯或约翰进行审问时，才会收到调查人员的消息。

sentences.en: Detectives Holden and Munro understood that nothing was being gained by keeping the Haggarts at a distance.
sentences.zh: 霍尔登和芒罗侦探明白，与哈格特一家保持距离毫无益处。

sentences.en: As such, they set about establishing a positive relationship with the family.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们着手与该家庭建立积极的关系。

sentences.en: After months of being kept in the dark, the Haggarts were now speaking regularly with police and receiving weekly updates on the case.
sentences.zh: 在被蒙在鼓里几个月后，哈格特一家现在定期与警方交谈，并每周收到案件的最新进展。

sentences.en: The initial investigators had presented a convincing set of circumstances to support the theory that the Haggart brothers were involved in Lawrence's death, especially Dennis.
sentences.zh: 最初的调查人员提出了一系列令人信服的情况，支持哈格特兄弟参与劳伦斯死亡的理论，尤其是丹尼斯。

sentences.en: Even though Detectives Holden and Munro were willing to explore other scenarios, they still had to rule out the possibility that someone in the household had committed the crime.
sentences.zh: 尽管霍尔登和芒罗侦探愿意探索其他方案，但他们仍然必须排除家中有人犯罪的可能性。

sentences.en: Renowned English criminal psychologist Adrian West was brought in to interview Dennis and John Haggart.
sentences.zh: 著名的英国刑事心理学家阿德里安·韦斯特被请来审问丹尼斯和约翰·哈格特。

sentences.en: After speaking with the pair, West concluded that there was no way either had killed Lawrence.
sentences.zh: 在与两人交谈后，韦斯特得出结论，他们两人都不可能杀害劳伦斯。

sentences.en: Superintendent Holden felt vindicated by this finding.
sentences.zh: 霍尔登警司对这一发现感到如释重负。

sentences.en: He'd been dubious about the brothers' involvement since first looking at the case.
sentences.zh: 他从第一次查看此案起就对兄弟俩的参与持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: To his thinking, the crime was simply too bizarre and too brutal for either to have done it.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，这起罪行实在太离奇、太残忍，他们两人都不可能做得出来。

sentences.en: He later told the Scotsman newspaper,
sentences.zh: 他后来告诉《苏格兰人报》：

sentences.en: We just had a gut feeling that the circumstances of the crime, the mutilation of Lawrence's shoulder, the motive that we felt was either sadistic or sexual,
sentences.zh: “我们有一种直觉，犯罪的情况、劳伦斯肩膀上的残缺，以及我们认为要么是施虐要么是性动机的动机，

sentences.en: could not be laid at the feet of Dennis, who was 12 at the time, or John.
sentences.zh: 都不可能归咎于当时12岁的丹尼斯或约翰身上。”

sentences.en: No brother could have done what was done to Lawrence, then tortured him, before going upstairs to his bedroom to sleep.
sentences.zh: “没有哪个兄弟能对劳伦斯做出那种事，折磨他，然后上楼回卧室睡觉。”

sentences.en: With Dennis and John Haggart ruled out, other suspects named in the original investigation were re-examined.
sentences.zh: 随着丹尼斯和约翰·哈格特被排除嫌疑，最初调查中提到的其他嫌疑人被重新审查。

sentences.en: One was a 31-year-old convicted sex offender named Brian Beattie.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是31岁的被定罪性犯罪者布莱恩·比蒂。

sentences.en: Beattie was the youngest of four brothers raised in the village of Aeth in the Falkirk Council area.
sentences.zh: 比蒂是在福尔柯克议会区埃斯村长大的四个兄弟中最小的一个。

sentences.en: As a child, he had attended a number of List D schools, a term for Scottish schools that were under the control of local social work departments.
sentences.zh: 小时候，他上过几所D类学校，这是对苏格兰受地方社会工作部门控制的学校的称呼。

sentences.en: His parents eventually separated when his mother pursued a relationship with another man.
sentences.zh: 他的父母最终分居了，因为他母亲与另一个男人开始了恋情。

sentences.en: She moved to the town of Radcar in England, where she got a job as a bus conductor.
sentences.zh: 她搬到了英国的雷德卡镇，在那里找到了一份售票员的工作。

sentences.en: The teenaged Beattie followed his mother to Radcar, where he began catching the same buses that she worked on.
sentences.zh: 十几岁的比蒂跟随母亲来到雷德卡，开始乘坐她工作的同一路公交车。

sentences.en: Beattie observed the travelling habits of local pensioners and would break in to their properties when he knew they would be out.
sentences.zh: 比蒂观察当地养老金领取者的出行习惯，并在知道他们外出时闯入他们的住所。

sentences.en: As well as stealing any valuables he found, he started fires in some of the residences.
sentences.zh: 除了偷走他发现的任何贵重物品外，他还在一些住所纵火。

sentences.en: He was arrested in 1984 and charged with four counts of burglary and two counts of arson.
sentences.zh: 他于1984年被捕，被控四项入室盗窃罪和两项纵火罪。

sentences.en: While on remand, Beattie set fire to his prison cell.
sentences.zh: 在还押期间，比蒂点燃了他的牢房。

sentences.en: He also attempted suicide by lighting himself on fire.
sentences.zh: 他还试图通过自焚来自杀。

sentences.en: Beattie pleaded guilty to all charges.
sentences.zh: 比蒂对所有指控供认不讳。

sentences.en: He was labelled a fire risk and a danger to the public.
sentences.zh: 他被贴上了火灾隐患和公共危险分子的标签。

sentences.en: The judge contemplated giving him a life sentence, but instead sentenced him to seven years.
sentences.zh: 法官曾考虑判处他终身监禁，但最终判处了他七年徒刑。

sentences.en: Beattie was released on parole four years later in 1988 and moved back to Scotland.
sentences.zh: 四年后的1988年，比蒂获得假释并搬回了苏格兰。

sentences.en: By November of that year, he had started a new series of crimes.
sentences.zh: 到那年11月，他开始了一系列新的犯罪活动。

sentences.en: Beattie would study houses around his hometown of Erth.
sentences.zh: 比蒂会研究他家乡埃斯附近的房屋。

sentences.en: This time, he took note of where adolescent boys lived.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他留意了青春期男孩居住的地方。

sentences.en: His first target was a house in the town of Stenhousemuir.
sentences.zh: 他的第一个目标是斯坦豪斯缪尔镇的一所房子。

sentences.en: Late one night, Beattie broke into the property and entered the bedroom of a 14-year-old boy.
sentences.zh: 一天深夜，比蒂闯入该房产，进入了一个14岁男孩的卧室。

sentences.en: Beattie tried to sexually assault the teen, but fled when his victim fought back.
sentences.zh: 比蒂试图性侵这名少年，但在受害者反抗时逃跑了。

sentences.en: More than 18 months later, in August 1990, Beattie broke into a house in Falkirk under the cover of darkness and attacked a 17-year-old male.
sentences.zh: 18个多月后的1990年8月，比蒂在夜幕掩护下闯入福尔柯克的一所房子，袭击了一名17岁的男性。

sentences.en: The victim woke to find Beattie pressing a pair of scissors against his stomach.
sentences.zh: 受害者醒来时，发现比蒂正用一把剪刀抵着他的腹部。

sentences.en: He was ordered to turn over and lie face down.
sentences.zh: 他被命令翻身趴下。

sentences.en: Beattie covered his head with a pillow and duvet while threatening to kill him if he looked at his face.
sentences.zh: 比蒂用枕头和羽绒被蒙住他的头，并威胁说如果他敢看自己的脸就杀了他。

sentences.en: He then sexually assaulted the boy before running from the scene.
sentences.zh: 随后，他在逃离现场前对这名男孩实施了性侵犯。

sentences.en: Three weeks later, a 21-year-old male was asleep in his family's home in Stenhousemuir.
sentences.zh: 三周后，一名21岁的男子在他位于斯坦豪斯缪尔的家中熟睡。

sentences.en: He woke to find Beattie holding a knife to his stomach.
sentences.zh: 他醒来时发现比蒂正拿着一把刀抵着他的腹部。

sentences.en: Beattie's other hand was pressed against the victim's genitals.
sentences.zh: 比蒂的另一只手正按在受害者的生殖器上。

sentences.en: He threatened to slash the young man if he moved, but the victim pushed him off and chased him from the room.
sentences.zh: 他威胁说如果受害者敢动就割伤他，但受害者将他推开并将其赶出了房间。

sentences.en: In October of 1990, Beattie targeted a house in Larbert, the town where Lawrence Haggard lived.
sentences.zh: 1990年10月，比蒂盯上了劳伦斯·哈格特居住的拉伯特镇的一所房子。

sentences.en: He threatened an 18-year-old male resident with a screwdriver before sexually assaulting him.
sentences.zh: 他用螺丝刀威胁了一名18岁的男住户，随后对他实施了性侵犯。

sentences.en: Within five days, Beattie struck again.
sentences.zh: 五天之内，比蒂再次作案。

sentences.en: He broke into a house belonging to a former Scottish football star and assaulted his 14-year-old son.
sentences.zh: 他闯入了一位前苏格兰足球明星的家中，并袭击了他14岁的儿子。

sentences.en: Beattie was eventually arrested for his string of attacks, but was released on bail.
sentences.zh: 比蒂最终因这一系列袭击被捕，但随后被保释。

sentences.en: Six days later, he assaulted a 21-year-old man at his home in Falkirk.
sentences.zh: 六天后，他在福尔柯克的家中袭击了一名21岁的男子。

sentences.en: In February 1991, Beattie faced Edinburgh's High Court charged with multiple counts of assault.
sentences.zh: 1991年2月，比蒂在爱丁堡高等法院受审，面临多项袭击指控。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to just 18 months in prison.
sentences.zh: 他仅被判处18个月监禁。

sentences.en: Within eight months, he had been granted parole.
sentences.zh: 八个月内，他就获得了假释。

sentences.en: Three days after his release, Beattie was loitering on a residential street in Stenhousemuir in the early hours of the morning.
sentences.zh: 获释三天后，比蒂在凌晨时分徘徊在斯坦豪斯缪尔的一条住宅街道上。

sentences.en: He silently entered a nearby house and made his way to the bedroom of the 16-year-old boy who lived there.
sentences.zh: 他悄悄进入附近的一所房子，径直走向住在那里的16岁男孩的卧室。

sentences.en: The teen was fast asleep.
sentences.zh: 那个少年睡得很沉。

sentences.en: Beattie covered the boy's head with a blanket and a t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 比蒂用毯子和一件T恤蒙住了男孩的头。

sentences.en: He warned him that he had a knife before tying the boy's wrists with a shirt and a wire.
sentences.zh: 他警告男孩自己有刀，随后用一件衬衫和一根电线绑住了男孩的手腕。

sentences.en: For the first time ever, Beattie ordered his victim out of their house.
sentences.zh: 这是比蒂第一次命令受害者离开自己的家。

sentences.en: He was going to carry out the assault elsewhere, at his own pace and under his full control.
sentences.zh: 他打算在别处实施袭击，按照自己的节奏，并完全掌控局面。

sentences.en: Yet, the boy managed to pull the covering from his head and saw his attacker's face.
sentences.zh: 然而，男孩设法扯掉了头上的遮盖物，看到了袭击者的脸。

sentences.en: Beattie fled, but was soon apprehended again.
sentences.zh: 比蒂逃跑了，但很快又被抓获。

sentences.en: This time, he was sentenced to five years in prison.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他被判处五年监禁。

sentences.en: In September 1994, he was once again released early on parole.
sentences.zh: 1994年9月，他再次获得提前假释。

sentences.en: He lived in Edinburgh for several months, then returned to the Falkirk area.
sentences.zh: 他在爱丁堡住了几个月，然后回到了福尔柯克地区。

sentences.en: Brian Beattie was questioned by police the day after Lawrence Haggart was attacked.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯·哈格特遇袭后的第二天，布莱恩·比蒂就受到了警方的盘问。

sentences.en: He provided an alibi, saying that he was at his brother's home until 9.30pm on March 15.
sentences.zh: 他提供了不在场证明，称3月15日晚上9点半之前他一直待在兄弟家里。

sentences.en: He then drove to Edinburgh and parked in the Grass Market, a historic market area in the city's old town.
sentences.zh: 随后他开车前往爱丁堡，停在旧城区历史悠久的草市。

sentences.en: He walked one and a half miles to a street called Royal Terrace, a known cruising area for gay men.
sentences.zh: 他步行一英里半到达了一条名为皇家露台的街道，那里是众所周知的男同性恋寻欢区。

sentences.en: Beattie said he arrived there by about 11pm and stayed in the area for around an hour and a half.
sentences.zh: 比蒂说他大约在晚上11点到达那里，并在该地区待了一个半小时左右。

sentences.en: During that time, he met a man and had oral sex with him.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，他遇到了一名男子并与他发生了口交。

sentences.en: The men parted ways after about 15 minutes without sharing names or any other personal information.
sentences.zh: 两人在大约15分钟后分道扬镳，没有交换姓名或任何其他个人信息。

sentences.en: Beattie said he arrived home by 2am.
sentences.zh: 比蒂说他凌晨2点前回到家。

sentences.en: When asked if he'd been near Lawrence Haggart's house, he replied,
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否曾靠近劳伦斯·哈格特的家时，他回答说：

sentences.en: I'm positive I wasn't in that area last night at all.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定昨晚我根本没去过那个区域。

sentences.en: Investigators at the time didn't believe the crime was sexually motivated.
sentences.zh: 当时的调查人员并不认为这起犯罪是出于性动机。

sentences.en: Beattie's alibi was accepted and he wasn't pursued any further as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 比蒂的不在场证明被接受了，他作为嫌疑人不再受到追查。

sentences.en: The scorched carpet and couch from the crime scene had been discarded during the initial investigation.
sentences.zh: 案发现场被烧焦的地毯和沙发在初步调查期间已被丢弃。

sentences.en: Neither item underwent a detailed forensic examination.
sentences.zh: 这两件物品都没有经过详细的法医鉴定。

sentences.en: This left investigators re-examining the case with little in the way of physical evidence.
sentences.zh: 这使得调查人员在重新审理此案时几乎没有任何物证。

sentences.en: All they had was a series of photographs taken at the scene and a pubic hair recovered from Lawrence's underwear.
sentences.zh: 他们手头仅有的就是现场拍摄的一系列照片，以及从劳伦斯的内裤中提取的一根阴毛。

sentences.en: Yet, the hair wasn't of any value.
sentences.zh: 然而，这根毛发没有任何价值。

sentences.en: Testing confirmed it belonged to Lawrence.
sentences.zh: 检测证实它属于劳伦斯本人。

sentences.en: Investigators sought assistance from the National Crime Facility think tank at the Police Staff College in Bramshill, England.
sentences.zh: 调查人员向位于英国布拉姆肖尔警察参谋学院的国家犯罪设施智库寻求协助。

sentences.en: They determined that Beattie was the only known criminal whose profile fit the circumstances surrounding Lawrence Haggart's murder.
sentences.zh: 他们断定比蒂是唯一已知的、其作案特征符合劳伦斯·哈格特谋杀案周边情况的罪犯。

sentences.en: He exclusively targeted adolescent boys and young men in their homes late at night.
sentences.zh: 他专门在深夜针对家中的青少年和年轻男性下手。

sentences.en: His attacks had occurred in or around the Falkirk area.
sentences.zh: 他的袭击都发生在福尔柯克地区或周边。

sentences.en: He had a history of committing arson to cover up his crimes.
sentences.zh: 他有通过纵火来掩盖罪行的前科。

sentences.en: And, in March of 1996, Beattie had lived in a caravan in Stenhousemuir, just a few miles from the Haggart home.
sentences.zh: 而且，1996年3月，比蒂住在距离哈格特家仅几英里的斯坦豪斯缪尔的一辆房车里。

sentences.en: By 1997, Brian Beattie still lived in Falkirk.
sentences.zh: 到1997年，布莱恩·比蒂仍然住在福尔柯克。

sentences.en: On Friday, August 22, police officers arrived at his home and placed him under arrest for willful fire raising.
sentences.zh: 8月22日星期五，警察来到他家，以蓄意纵火罪将他逮捕。

sentences.en: The charge related to an incident that had occurred six months earlier in February and allowed police to hold Beattie for questioning for an extended period.
sentences.zh: 这项指控与六个月前二月份发生的一起事件有关，这使得警方能够将比蒂拘留并进行长时间的审讯。

sentences.en: The following day, a search of Beattie's residence was carried out.
sentences.zh: 第二天，警方对比蒂的住所进行了搜查。

sentences.en: Drawers in his bedroom contained two videotapes.
sentences.zh: 他卧室的抽屉里有两盘录像带。

sentences.en: Both were pornographic films that had been recorded from a German satellite channel.
sentences.zh: 两盘都是从德国卫星频道录制的色情电影。

sentences.en: One was titled Redemption – The Abduction Series Part 3.
sentences.zh: 其中一盘名为《救赎——绑架系列第三部》。

sentences.en: It depicted fantasy scenarios in which young men were kidnapped from their homes, then used as sexual slaves.
sentences.zh: 它描绘了年轻人从家中被绑架，然后被当作性奴隶的幻想场景。

sentences.en: Some of the footage showed the men being whipped and tied up with strips of cloth.
sentences.zh: 部分片段显示这些人被鞭打并用布条捆绑。

sentences.en: Beattie was questioned by detectives multiple times over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，侦探对比蒂进行了多次审讯。

sentences.en: Lawrence Haggart's murder was discussed, though Beattie maintained he had nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 虽然讨论了劳伦斯·哈格特的谋杀案，但比蒂坚称自己与此无关。

sentences.en: Towards the end of one interview, however, he suddenly broke down in tears.
sentences.zh: 然而，在一次审讯快结束时，他突然崩溃大哭。

sentences.en: He then began shaking, wailing and sobbing.
sentences.zh: 他开始颤抖、哀号和抽泣。

sentences.en: Detective Gordon Munro thought he looked like a child trapped in an adult's body.
sentences.zh: 戈登·芒罗侦探认为他看起来就像一个被困在成年人身体里的孩子。

sentences.en: Beattie admitted that he had, quote, urges that disgusted him.
sentences.zh: 比蒂承认他有“令自己感到恶心的冲动”。

sentences.en: The interview concluded there.
sentences.zh: 审讯到此结束。

sentences.en: During another interview, in which Beattie was crying and distressed,
sentences.zh: 在另一次审讯中，比蒂哭泣且情绪激动，

sentences.en: Detective Joe Holden asked him if he had killed Lawrence Haggart.
sentences.zh: 乔·霍尔登侦探问他是否杀害了劳伦斯·哈格特。

sentences.en: Beattie nodded his head firmly about six times.
sentences.zh: 比蒂坚定地点了点头，大约点了六次。

sentences.en: Holden inquired,
sentences.zh: 霍尔登追问：

sentences.en: Does that mean yes, Brian?
sentences.zh: 布莱恩，这意思是肯定的吗？

sentences.en: Beattie replied that it did, then said he wanted to speak about it with his brother.
sentences.zh: 比蒂回答说是，然后说他想和他的兄弟谈谈这件事。

sentences.en: The police fetched Beattie's brother, but when the pair spoke, Beattie reasserted his innocence.
sentences.zh: 警方找来了比蒂的兄弟，但当两人交谈时，比蒂又重申了自己的清白。

sentences.en: After this incident, Beattie reportedly told police he would confess on the condition that he wasn't recorded.
sentences.zh: 据报道，在此次事件后，比蒂告诉警方，如果不在录音的情况下，他愿意认罪。

sentences.en: Interviewing officers agreed and instead took detailed notes in a police notebook as he spoke.
sentences.zh: 审讯警官同意了，并在他讲述时在警用笔记本上做了详细记录。

sentences.en: According to Detective Munro, Beattie explained that he was outside at the Haggart family home on the night of March 16, 1996.
sentences.zh: 据芒罗侦探称，比蒂解释说1996年3月16日晚上，他就在哈格特家外面。

sentences.en: Some neighbours across the road were having a party and a taxi arrived to either pick up or drop off a gueSt.
sentences.zh: 马路对面的一些邻居正在开派对，一辆出租车过来接送客人。

sentences.en: Beattie approached the Haggart house and entered via the front door, which was apparently unlocked.
sentences.zh: 比蒂靠近哈格特家，从前门进入，门显然没锁。

sentences.en: He walked towards the living room door, which was shut.
sentences.zh: 他走向客厅门，门是关着的。

sentences.en: Beattie peered through its glass panes and saw Lawrence lying on the couch with a duvet or blanket pulled over him.
sentences.zh: 比蒂透过玻璃窗往里看，看到劳伦斯躺在沙发上，身上盖着羽绒被或毯子。

sentences.en: Beattie opened the door and entered the room.
sentences.zh: 比蒂打开门进入房间。

sentences.en: Upon seeing the stranger, Lawrence got up and spoke.
sentences.zh: 看到陌生人，劳伦斯起身说话。

sentences.en: Beattie couldn't recall what he said.
sentences.zh: 比蒂记不清他说了什么。

sentences.en: Beattie then hit Lawrence.
sentences.zh: 接着比蒂打了劳伦斯。

sentences.en: He told investigators, quote,
sentences.zh: 他告诉调查人员，引用原话：

sentences.en: I can remember his face.
sentences.zh: 我记得他的脸。

sentences.en: I will never forget it.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: He fell back on the couch and I hit him again.
sentences.zh: 他倒在沙发上，我又打了他一次。

sentences.en: I keep remembering the fear in his face.
sentences.zh: 我一直记得他脸上的恐惧。

sentences.en: Beattie said he couldn't recall how many times he struck Lawrence.
sentences.zh: 比蒂说他记不清自己打了劳伦斯多少次。

sentences.en: He insisted he had not taken a weapon with him, but was certain he must have used one, as his hands bore no injuries the following day.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己没有随身携带武器，但肯定自己一定用了某种武器，因为第二天他的手上没有任何伤痕。

sentences.en: The next thing he said he remembered was running away down the street.
sentences.zh: 他记得的下一件事就是沿着街道跑开。

sentences.en: Beattie then returned to his caravan, where he quickly fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 比蒂随后回到他的房车，很快就睡着了。

sentences.en: He rose early the next morning and went to a lay-by near a highway to burn his clothing.
sentences.zh: 第二天一早他起床，去公路旁的一个停车带烧掉了自己的衣服。

sentences.en: He claimed he'd buried some articles of Lawrence's clothing that he had taken with him.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己埋掉了一些他随身带走的劳伦斯的衣物。

sentences.en: Beattie allegedly offered to take officers to the locations, as well as along the route he'd walked from his caravan to the Haggart house.
sentences.zh: 据称，比蒂主动提出带警察去这些地点，以及他从房车走到哈格特家的路线。

sentences.en: Nothing in the confession referred to the mutilation of Lawrence's shoulder or the numbers written in ink on his hands.
sentences.zh: 供词中没有任何内容提到劳伦斯肩膀的残缺，也没有提到他手上用墨水写的数字。

sentences.en: Beattie theorised that he'd committed the crime because he had been distraught about the recent mass shooting at Dunblane Primary School.
sentences.zh: 比蒂推测他犯下这起罪行是因为他对最近发生的邓布兰小学大规模枪击事件感到心烦意乱。

sentences.en: According to the police notes, Beattie also said he felt bad about the fact that Lawrence's brothers had been considered suspects in the murder.
sentences.zh: 根据警方记录，比蒂还表示，他对劳伦斯的兄弟们被列为谋杀案嫌疑人感到难过。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用：

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用：

sentences.en: When later presented with the transcribed notes of his confession, Beattie refused to sign them.
sentences.zh: 后来当比蒂被出示供词笔录时，他拒绝签字。

sentences.en: He remained on remand for his fire-raising charge as the Haggart investigation continued.
sentences.zh: 随着哈格特案调查的继续，他因纵火指控继续被还押候审。

sentences.en: Dozens of police officers searched the Falkirk countryside for the evidence that Beattie had allegedly burned following Lawrence's murder.
sentences.zh: 数十名警察在福尔柯克的乡村地区搜寻比蒂据称在劳伦斯遇害后烧毁的证据。

sentences.en: Yet, nothing of significance was found.
sentences.zh: 然而，没有发现任何有价值的东西。

sentences.en: The Haggart family was privately informed that there was a suspect in custody, but the news didn't break in the media until three months later in October.
sentences.zh: 哈格特一家私下获悉有一名嫌疑人被拘留，但直到三个月后的10月，媒体才报道了这一消息。

sentences.en: Larry Haggart told the Daily Record that the police in charge of the case were doing a great job,
sentences.zh: 拉里·哈格特告诉《每日记录报》，负责此案的警察做得非常出色，

sentences.en: but he was reluctant to get his hopes up until the suspect was charged for Lawrence's murder.
sentences.zh: 但他不愿抱太大希望，直到嫌疑人因劳伦斯的谋杀案被起诉。

sentences.en: He described the earlier speculation about Dennis and John's involvement in the crime as a disgrace, adding, It was shocking what my sons went through.
sentences.zh: 他称早先关于丹尼斯和约翰涉案的猜测是一种耻辱，并补充说：我儿子们所经历的一切令人震惊。

sentences.en: Knowing the person responsible was still at large meant my family have not had the chance to grieve properly.
sentences.zh: 知道肇事者仍然逍遥法外，意味着我的家人一直没能好好地哀悼。

sentences.en: Then, on November 7, 1997, 33-year-old Brian Beattie was formally charged with Lawrence Haggart's murder and for fire-raising in the Haggart home.
sentences.zh: 随后，1997年11月7日，33岁的布莱恩·比蒂被正式指控犯有劳伦斯·哈格特谋杀罪以及在哈格特家纵火罪。

sentences.en: Brian Beattie entered a plea of not guilty.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·比蒂拒不认罪。

sentences.en: His trial began six months later in April 1998 at Edinburgh's High Court.
sentences.zh: 六个月后的1998年4月，他的审判在爱丁堡高等法院开始。

sentences.en: John Haggart took the stand and wept as he detailed how he had discovered his brother's beaten and burning body, then desperately tried to save his life.
sentences.zh: 约翰·哈格特出庭作证，在详细描述他如何发现兄弟被殴打并燃烧的尸体，随后拼命试图挽救他的生命时，他泪流满面。

sentences.en: During cross-examination, John admitted that he withheld knowledge of Lawrence's argument with Dennis for two weeks before coming clean to investigators.
sentences.zh: 在交叉询问中，约翰承认他在向调查人员坦白之前，隐瞒了劳伦斯与丹尼斯争吵的事实长达两周。

sentences.en: John described that fortnight as hellish and said he'd kept the fight a secret because he could tell the police suspected Dennis.
sentences.zh: 约翰形容那两周简直是地狱，并说他一直保守着争吵的秘密，因为他看得出警方在怀疑丹尼斯。

sentences.en: John had wanted to protect the only brother he had left.
sentences.zh: 约翰想保护他仅剩的唯一兄弟。

sentences.en: He conceded that he found Dennis physically intimidating and had been briefly suspicious of him.
sentences.zh: 他承认他觉得丹尼斯在身体上很有威慑力，并且曾短暂地怀疑过他。

sentences.en: However, when the prosecution asked whether he thought Dennis was capable of the crime, John replied, Not really.
sentences.zh: 然而，当控方询问他是否认为丹尼斯有能力犯下此罪时，约翰回答说：不太可能。

sentences.en: If it was just a fight or something, you could understand.
sentences.zh: 如果只是打架什么的，你还能理解。

sentences.en: But what actually happened to Lawrence?
sentences.zh: 但劳伦斯身上到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: No way.
sentences.zh: 绝不可能。

sentences.en: Dennis Haggart was now 14 years old.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·哈格特当时已经14岁了。

sentences.en: Before he began his testimony, the judge cautioned him that he wasn't required to answer any questions that might incriminate him.
sentences.zh: 在他开始作证之前，法官提醒他，他无需回答任何可能使自己入罪的问题。

sentences.en: Following prodding from the defence, Dennis described a fight that he'd had with Lawrence several weeks before the murder.
sentences.zh: 在辩方的追问下，丹尼斯描述了他在谋杀案发生前几周与劳伦斯发生的一次争吵。

sentences.en: On that occasion, Lawrence had thrown a dart at his younger brother's leg, which pierced his skin.
sentences.zh: 那次，劳伦斯向他弟弟的腿扔了一支飞镖，刺穿了他的皮肤。

sentences.en: The defence suggested Dennis murdered Lawrence in revenge.
sentences.zh: 辩方暗示丹尼斯是出于报复杀害了劳伦斯。

sentences.en: Quote, You were not the same kind of star at football, and that was why you burned his legs, because you were jealous and angry.
sentences.zh: 引用：你不是那种足球明星，这就是你烧他腿的原因，因为你嫉妒且愤怒。

sentences.en: Dennis was adamant that he hadn't, telling the court that he had been proud of Lawrence.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯坚决否认，告诉法庭他一直为劳伦斯感到骄傲。

sentences.en: Detective Gordon Munro told the court of Brian Beattie's confession, which the defence was firmly rejecting.
sentences.zh: 戈登·芒罗侦探向法庭讲述了布莱恩·比蒂的供词，辩方对此坚决予以否认。

sentences.en: The document had been penned by police while Beattie was in custody, and he'd refused to sign it.
sentences.zh: 这份文件是比蒂被拘留期间由警方撰写的，他拒绝签字。

sentences.en: They maintained that their client was in Edinburgh from about 11pm to 2am the night of Lawrence Haggart's murder.
sentences.zh: 他们坚持认为他们的当事人在劳伦斯·哈格特遇害当晚从晚上11点到凌晨2点一直待在爱丁堡。

sentences.en: However, a man who lived in the caravan next to Beattie's contradicted this claim.
sentences.zh: 然而，住在比蒂房车隔壁的一名男子反驳了这一说法。

sentences.en: He said that he'd heard Beattie return home in his car between 10 and 11 that night, and didn't hear the car's engine again.
sentences.zh: 他说他听到比蒂那天晚上10点到11点之间开车回家，之后就没再听到汽车引擎声了。

sentences.en: When he went outside at 1.30am to dispose of some rubbish, the vehicle was in its usual parking spot.
sentences.zh: 当他在凌晨1点30分出去倒垃圾时，那辆车停在它平时的停车位上。

sentences.en: Brian Beattie told the court that the police had concocted his entire confession.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·比蒂告诉法庭，警方捏造了他所有的供词。

sentences.en: He alleged that they had beaten him and used his nephews as leverage by threatening to put them into care, and alleged that Beattie was molesting them.
sentences.zh: 他声称他们殴打了自己，并以他的侄子为筹码，威胁要把他们送进福利院，并指控比蒂猥亵他们。

sentences.en: He said that he'd never admitted to the murder and had refused to sign the transcribed confession, because it was entirely false.
sentences.zh: 他说他从未承认谋杀，并拒绝签署那份供词笔录，因为那完全是假的。

sentences.en: When the prosecution cross-examined Beattie, they accused him of having fantasies about abducting young men.
sentences.zh: 当控方对比蒂进行交叉询问时，他们指控他有绑架年轻男性的幻想。

sentences.en: He denied this.
sentences.zh: 他否认了这一点。

sentences.en: Beattie said that he had only watched between 5 to 15 minutes of the pornographic video found in his home, before switching it off because he didn't like it.
sentences.zh: 比蒂说他只看了家里发现的那盘色情录像带的5到15分钟，因为不喜欢就关掉了。

sentences.en: During his testimony, Beattie began to sob.
sentences.zh: 在作证期间，比蒂开始抽泣。

sentences.en: When asked why he was crying, he said,
sentences.zh: 当被问及为什么哭时，他说：

sentences.en: Because I am accused of this murder.
sentences.zh: 因为我被指控犯有这起谋杀案。

sentences.en: I am not guilty.
sentences.zh: 我是无辜的。

sentences.en: In summing up, the defence told the jury that the police had fabricated Beattie's confession because they were desperate to close the case.
sentences.zh: 在总结陈词中，辩方告诉陪审团，警方捏造了比蒂的供词，因为他们急于结案。

sentences.en: His lawyer told the court,
sentences.zh: 他的律师告诉法庭：

sentences.en: They pointed out that the interview in which Beattie allegedly confessed had not been recorded, as others had been.
sentences.zh: 他们指出，比蒂据称供认的那次审讯并没有像其他审讯那样进行录音。

sentences.en: The prosecution stated that if the police had indeed fabricated the confession, then they were such talented actors that they should be members of the Royal Shakespeare Company.
sentences.zh: 检方表示，如果警方确实伪造了供词，那么他们一定是演技高超的演员，应该去皇家莎士比亚剧团工作。

sentences.en: They asserted that Beattie had broken down on the stand because he was haunted by his guilt.
sentences.zh: 他们断言，比蒂在证人席上崩溃是因为他被自己的罪恶感所折磨。

sentences.en: Before the jury was dismissed for deliberations, Judge Lord Thomas Dawson made it clear to them that their verdict hinged on Beattie's alleged confession.
sentences.zh: 在陪审团退庭商议之前，托马斯·道森勋爵法官明确告诉他们，他们的裁决取决于比蒂所谓的供词。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: Either the police officers are lying or the accused is not telling us the truth.
sentences.zh: 要么是警察在撒谎，要么就是被告没有对我们说实话。

sentences.en: The jury returned with a verdict that same day.
sentences.zh: 陪审团当天就做出了裁决。

sentences.en: They found Brian Beattie guilty of the murder of Lawrence Haggart and of fire-raising.
sentences.zh: 他们认定布莱恩·比蒂犯有谋杀劳伦斯·哈格特和纵火罪。

sentences.en: The courtroom erupted in cheers and applause.
sentences.zh: 法庭内爆发出欢呼和掌声。

sentences.en: In addressing Beattie, Judge Dawson described his unprovoked attack brutal and ferocious.
sentences.zh: 在对比蒂进行宣判时，道森法官形容他的无端袭击是残忍而凶猛的。

sentences.en: He added that Beattie's criminal history was very serious and he was an extreme danger to the public.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，比蒂的犯罪记录非常严重，对公众构成了极大的危险。

sentences.en: Judge Dawson sentenced Beattie to life in prison, with a minimum of 15 years.
sentences.zh: 道森法官判处比蒂终身监禁，最低服刑15年。

sentences.en: His sentence for fire-raising would run concurrently with his sentence for murder.
sentences.zh: 他的纵火罪刑期将与谋杀罪刑期同时执行。

sentences.en: Larry Haggart was grateful to those who conducted the renewed investigation into his son's murder.
sentences.zh: 拉里·哈格特对那些对儿子谋杀案进行重新调查的人表示感谢。

sentences.en: Yet, he remained angry that it had taken more than two years to identify and convict Lawrence's killer.
sentences.zh: 然而，他仍然感到愤怒，因为花了两年多的时间才查明并定罪劳伦斯的杀手。

sentences.en: He accused Scotland Police of botching the investigation by failing to verify Beattie's alibi and for not singling him out as a likely suspect based on his criminal history.
sentences.zh: 他指责苏格兰警方搞砸了调查，未能核实比蒂的不在场证明，也没有根据他的犯罪记录将他列为主要嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Larry also stated that by focusing on Dennis as the perpetrator, the police had given Beattie a plan of defence.
sentences.zh: 拉里还表示，由于警方将注意力集中在丹尼斯身上，反而给了比蒂一个辩护计划。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of the trial, the Haggart family lodged a civil complaint against Central Scotland Police.
sentences.zh: 审判结束后，哈格特一家对苏格兰中部警方提起了民事诉讼。

sentences.en: It addressed the investigation team's mishandling of the case and their poor conduct towards the Haggarts, including the persistent and baseless pursuit of Dennis as the killer.
sentences.zh: 诉讼内容涉及调查组对案件的处理不当，以及他们对哈格特一家的恶劣态度，包括坚持且毫无根据地追查丹尼斯作为凶手。

sentences.en: Dennis and John Haggart were awarded £20,000 in compensation.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯和约翰·哈格特获得了2万英镑的赔偿。

sentences.en: The police issued a public apology, stating that the family should have received a much better performance.
sentences.zh: 警方发表了公开道歉，称哈格特一家本应得到更好的服务。

sentences.en: They were assured that the force had rectified its approach so that the same mistakes wouldn't be repeated.
sentences.zh: 他们得到保证，警方已经纠正了工作方法，以确保同样的错误不会再犯。

sentences.en: Larry Haggart told BBC Scotland that he welcomed the apology, but he wanted the officers involved sacked.
sentences.zh: 拉里·哈格特告诉英国广播公司苏格兰频道，他欢迎道歉，但他希望涉案警官被解雇。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下，

sentences.en: In mid-1998, an independent inquiry was held to determine what exactly went wrong in Central Scotland Police's initial investigation into Lawrence Haggart's murder.
sentences.zh: 1998年中期，一项独立调查启动，旨在确定苏格兰中部警方在劳伦斯·哈格特谋杀案的初步调查中究竟出了什么问题。

sentences.en: Conducting the inquiry was Assistant Chief Constable James Mackay of the Tayside Police.
sentences.zh: 负责这项调查的是泰赛德警方的助理警察局长詹姆斯·麦凯。

sentences.en: His findings were published three months later in a document dubbed the Mackay Report.
sentences.zh: 他的调查结果在三个月后发布，这份文件被称为《麦凯报告》。

sentences.en: The details and outcome of the report were withheld from the public, including the Haggart family.
sentences.zh: 报告的细节和结果对公众保密，包括哈格特一家在内。

sentences.en: Journalist Russell Finlay had covered the case extensively for the Sunday Mail and was intrigued as to why the report had been suppressed.
sentences.zh: 记者罗素·芬利曾为《星期日邮报》广泛报道过此案，他对比为何这份报告会被压制感到好奇。

sentences.en: But there was no avenue for him or anyone else to gain access to it.
sentences.zh: 但他和其他人都没有途径获取这份报告。

sentences.en: Seven years later, in 2005, British Prime Minister Tony Blair passed the UK's Freedom of Information Act.
sentences.zh: 七年后的2005年，英国首相托尼·布莱尔通过了英国的《信息自由法》。

sentences.en: This allowed members of the public to request access to information held by public authorities.
sentences.zh: 这允许公众要求获取公共机构持有的信息。

sentences.en: Russell Finlay later wrote in his book, Acid Attack, A Journalist's War with Organised Crime.
sentences.zh: 罗素·芬利后来在他的书《酸性攻击：一名记者与有组织犯罪的战争》中写道。

sentences.en: The report revealed that in 1994, while serving time for abducting a teenage boy, Brian Beattie said he wished he'd killed his victim so that he could have escaped arreSt.
sentences.zh: 报告显示，1994年，布莱恩·比蒂在因绑架一名十几岁男孩服刑期间，曾说他希望自己杀了受害者，这样就能逃避逮捕。

sentences.en: Social workers warned that Beattie was at high risk of re-offending, but he was released early on parole.
sentences.zh: 社会工作者曾警告说，比蒂再次犯罪的风险很高，但他还是被提前假释了。

sentences.en: By 1996, he had faded back into the Falkirk community.
sentences.zh: 到1996年，他已经悄然回到了福尔柯克社区。

sentences.en: Then, he was questioned in relation to the Lawrence Haggart case.
sentences.zh: 随后，他因劳伦斯·哈格特案受到盘问。

sentences.en: The police accepted his alibi and he was promptly ruled out.
sentences.zh: 警方接受了他的不在场证明，并迅速排除了他的嫌疑。

sentences.en: The Mackay report confirmed that no effort was made to verify Beattie's whereabouts on the night of Lawrence's attack.
sentences.zh: 《麦凯报告》证实，警方在劳伦斯遇袭当晚根本没有努力核实比蒂的行踪。

sentences.en: Additionally, Beattie's criminal record wasn't accessed by investigators until almost a year later.
sentences.zh: 此外，调查人员直到近一年后才查阅比蒂的犯罪记录。

sentences.en: It also noted that they didn't consider that the crime could have been sexually motivated.
sentences.zh: 报告还指出，他们没有考虑到这起犯罪可能是出于性动机。

sentences.en: Furthermore, two officers had searched Beattie's car and caravan following the attack.
sentences.zh: 此外，两名警官在袭击发生后搜查了比蒂的汽车和大篷车。

sentences.en: They discovered a hammer and a petrol container, but disregarded them.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了一把锤子和一个汽油桶，但却没当回事。

sentences.en: In one of Beattie's previous attacks, he had struck a victim over the head with a glass bottle.
sentences.zh: 在比蒂之前的袭击中，他曾用玻璃瓶击打受害者的头部。

sentences.en: A glass bottle was found in the Haggart's kitchen, but wasn't flagged as significant.
sentences.zh: 哈格特家的厨房里发现了一个玻璃瓶，但并未被标记为重要证据。

sentences.en: Another potential weapon went missing when a piece of green metal was collected from the home, but never logged as evidence.
sentences.zh: 另一件潜在的凶器在从家中收集到一块绿色金属片时丢失了，且从未被记录为证据。

sentences.en: The report detailed how fire investigators had examined the living room for 90 minutes immediately after the attack.
sentences.zh: 报告详细说明了火灾调查人员在袭击发生后立即对客厅进行了90分钟的检查。

sentences.en: This was before the area was secured and examined for crucial evidence, such as finger or footprints.
sentences.zh: 这发生在现场被封锁并检查关键证据（如指纹或脚印）之前。

sentences.en: Then, there was the discovery that detectives had faked diary entries in relation to their investigation.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有发现侦探在调查过程中伪造了日记条目。

sentences.en: The fraudulent entries were exposed by the author's habit of referring to Lawrence as the deceased prior to his actual death.
sentences.zh: 这些欺诈性的条目被作者的习惯所揭露，他在劳伦斯实际死亡之前就称他为死者。

sentences.en: The report also addressed confusion surrounding the discovery of a hammer in the Haggart's kitchen.
sentences.zh: 报告还讨论了围绕在哈格特家厨房发现锤子的困惑。

sentences.en: One officer who inspected the property with a team of experts two days after the attack stated that if the hammer was on the kitchen table at the time, they would have seen it.
sentences.zh: 一名在袭击发生两天后与专家组一起检查该房产的警官表示，如果当时锤子在厨房桌子上，他们肯定会看到。

sentences.en: The Haggart house was searched nine times before Detective Sergeant Robert Beveridge said he'd stumbled across the item by chance during a visit one week after the attack.
sentences.zh: 哈格特家被搜查了九次，之后侦探警长罗伯特·贝弗里奇才说他在袭击发生一周后的一次访问中偶然发现了该物品。

sentences.en: According to Assistant Chief Constable Mackay, the corrupt actions of investigating officers were intended to pin the crime on 12-year-old Dennis Haggart.
sentences.zh: 据助理警察局长麦凯称，调查警官的腐败行为旨在将罪名嫁祸给12岁的丹尼斯·哈格特。

sentences.en: These included portions dealing with a criminal probe against the officers involved in the original investigation.
sentences.zh: 其中包括处理针对原始调查中涉案警官的刑事调查的部分。

sentences.en: Only a few received any disciplinary action.
sentences.zh: 只有少数人受到了纪律处分。

sentences.en: The case's second-in-command, Detective Inspector John Bunyan, was suspended in August of 1998.
sentences.zh: 该案的二把手，侦探督察约翰·邦扬，于1998年8月被停职。

sentences.en: He faced five charges, including two counts of discredible conduct and three charges of neglect of duty.
sentences.zh: 他面临五项指控，包括两项行为不检罪和三项玩忽职守罪。

sentences.en: The latter three charges were dropped after a lengthy disciplinary hearing.
sentences.zh: 在漫长的纪律听证会后，后三项指控被撤销。

sentences.en: Inspector Bunyan was only found guilty of the two lesser offences of discredible conduct.
sentences.zh: 邦扬督察仅被判两项较轻的行为不检罪成立。

sentences.en: Detective Sergeant Robert Beveridge, the officer who planted the hammer in the Haggart's kitchen,
sentences.zh: 侦探警长罗伯特·贝弗里奇，即那个在哈格特家厨房放置锤子的警官，

sentences.en: was transferred out of the criminal investigation department, as was another sergeant.
sentences.zh: 被调离了刑事调查部门，另一名警长也被调离。

sentences.en: The case's former lead investigator, Detective Superintendent Jim Winning, avoided discipline by retiring from the force.
sentences.zh: 该案的前首席调查员，侦探警司吉姆·威宁，通过从警队退休避免了纪律处分。

sentences.en: Aged in his 40s, Winning cited health reasons for his early departure.
sentences.zh: 40多岁的威宁以健康原因为由提前离职。

sentences.en: Central Scotland Police had attempted to block his retirement, but were unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 苏格兰中部警方曾试图阻止他退休，但未获成功。

sentences.en: Larry Haggart voiced his family's disappointment, telling the press,
sentences.zh: 拉里·哈格特表达了家人的失望，他告诉媒体，

sentences.en: We have been fighting to get a bit of justice for our family for years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我们一直在为家人争取一点正义。

sentences.en: I just feel we haven't got it.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我们没有得到。

sentences.en: There is somebody answerable to the way we were treated, and as far as I'm concerned, nobody has come up with the answer yet.
sentences.zh: 有人必须为我们所受的待遇负责，就我而言，还没有人给出答案。

sentences.en: In 2003, Brian Beattie lost an appeal against his conviction.
sentences.zh: 2003年，布莱恩·比蒂上诉定罪失败。

sentences.en: He was denied parole in 2012, and remains incarcerated as of the release of this episode.
sentences.zh: 他在2012年被拒绝假释，截至本集发布时，他仍被监禁。

sentences.en: In October 2015, one of Beattie's nephews came forward to accuse his uncle of molesting him.
sentences.zh: 2015年10月，比蒂的一名侄子站出来指控他的叔叔猥亵他。

sentences.en: Michael, not his real name, told The Sun, that Beattie started abusing him in 1994, when Michael was 13 years old.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔（化名）告诉《太阳报》，比蒂从1994年开始虐待他，当时迈克尔才13岁。

sentences.en: He would serve Michael sugary alcoholic beverages known as Alcopops, then rape him.
sentences.zh: 他会给迈克尔喝含糖的酒精饮料，即所谓的“预调酒”，然后强奸他。

sentences.en: Michael told The Sun, quote,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔告诉《太阳报》，引用如下，

sentences.en: It was so traumatic I blocked it out.
sentences.zh: 那太痛苦了，我把它封锁在记忆之外了。

sentences.en: It was horrific.
sentences.zh: 那太可怕了。

sentences.en: There were hundreds of incidents over a spell of three years.
sentences.zh: 在三年时间里，发生了数百起事件。

sentences.en: I would regularly wake up some days with no clothes on and him lying next to me.
sentences.zh: 我经常在某天醒来时发现自己没穿衣服，而他就躺在我身边。

sentences.en: There were times where I'd be upstairs doing my homework, and he'd just come into my room and start doing stuff to me.
sentences.zh: 有时我在楼上做作业，他就会直接走进我的房间，开始对我做那些事。

sentences.en: Michael was scared that if he fought back, Beattie might start abusing his brothers instead.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔很害怕，如果他反抗，比蒂可能会转而虐待他的兄弟们。

sentences.en: After Lawrence Haggart was murdered in March 1996, Beattie took Michael for a walk past the Haggart house.
sentences.zh: 1996年3月劳伦斯·哈格特被谋杀后，比蒂带着迈克尔走过哈格特家。

sentences.en: He told his nephew that he had killed Lawrence, and if Michael ever told anyone, then he would kill him as well.
sentences.zh: 他告诉侄子，是他杀了劳伦斯，如果迈克尔告诉任何人，他也会杀了他。

sentences.en: According to Michael, Beattie threatened his life on multiple occasions.
sentences.zh: 据迈克尔说，比蒂多次威胁他的生命。

sentences.en: He once held a razor to Michael's throat.
sentences.zh: 他曾把剃须刀架在迈克尔的喉咙上。

sentences.en: Another time, he claimed to have a gun hidden under a bridge that he would use to kill him.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，他声称在桥下藏了一把枪，要用它杀了他。

sentences.en: After Beattie was convicted for murder, he sent Michael a letter.
sentences.zh: 比蒂因谋杀罪被定罪后，给迈克尔寄了一封信。

sentences.en: In it, he said he had naked photos of Michael.
sentences.zh: 信中说他有迈克尔的裸照。

sentences.en: He blackmailed Michael into staying silent by threatening to release the images to his friends and family.
sentences.zh: 他威胁要将这些照片发布给迈克尔的朋友和家人，以此勒索他保持沉默。

sentences.en: Michael became a Royal Logistics Corps soldier, but struggled with post-traumatic stress disorder, anxiety, and maintaining employment as a consequence of the abuse.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔后来成为了一名皇家后勤部队的士兵，但由于虐待，他一直饱受创伤后应激障碍、焦虑症的困扰，且难以维持工作。

sentences.en: His personal relationships also suffered.
sentences.zh: 他的个人关系也受到了影响。

sentences.en: He told The Sun,
sentences.zh: 他告诉《太阳报》，

sentences.en: In March 2016, a football tournament was held in honour of Lawrence Haggart near his hometown.
sentences.zh: 2016年3月，在劳伦斯·哈格特的家乡附近举办了一场足球锦标赛，以纪念他。

sentences.en: More than 100 players took part.
sentences.zh: 超过100名球员参加了比赛。

sentences.en: A charity auction was also held in conjunction with the event to raise funds for a local girl battling cancer.
sentences.zh: 活动期间还举行了慈善拍卖，为一名患癌的当地女孩筹集资金。

sentences.en: Lawrence's brother, Dennis, gave an interview to the Scotsman newspaper about the event.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯的兄弟丹尼斯接受了《苏格兰人报》关于此次活动的采访。

sentences.en: After Lawrence's death, his father Larry continued to be involved in football by helping to coach a youth team.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯去世后，他的父亲拉里继续参与足球运动，帮助执教一支青年队。

sentences.en: He told the Herald Scotland that doing so helped with his mental health.
sentences.zh: 他告诉《苏格兰先驱报》，这样做有助于他的心理健康。

sentences.en: When things got too difficult, he would re-watch home movies of Lawrence playing the sport.
sentences.zh: 当事情变得太困难时，他会重温劳伦斯踢球的家庭录像。

sentences.en: Larry often paused the videos at moments that reminded him of happy memories with his son.
sentences.zh: 拉里经常在那些让他想起与儿子快乐时光的片段处暂停视频。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下，

sentences.en: I had a lot of good times.
sentences.zh: 我度过了许多美好时光。

sentences.en: It was short, but it was a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 虽然短暂，但那是一种快乐。
